records.rule: Work is occupation-like free text; its business semantics are inferred, not a source catalogue key.
Decode latin1, NFC, trim outer whitespace; preserve internal display text; collapse whitespace only for comparison.
Valid nonblank max-100 control-free text is a direct nullable free-text candidate.
Blank maps null plus absence provenance; never unknown, unemployed or other.
Invalid/control/encoding/overlength value is withheld at field level and does not block patient.
Do not populate sett_ocuupation, fabricate a catalogue, or force config occupation labels.
Occupation is prohibited for identity, matching, deduplication and payer inference.
Existing target value, including null, is immutable; differences are protected comparison outcomes.
Parent unresolved or quarantined holds the field under the patient root.
Extraction/snapshot failure withholds the field and root until reproducible.
